text:
miriam: Quick status check — can folks post a short snapshot for the AcmePrivate rollout? Need owner for remaining network gaps (firewall/NAT), any air-gap blockers, and CR review status. target: cutover next Tue.

devon: On firewall rules — I've got the inbound CIDR list. Waiting on customer to confirm their NAT egress IPs. pinging them again today. @miriam

kai: Workload owner for canaries here. Canary flows pass on staging but fail TLS handshake on customer infra. Getting `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` on client side.

ops-bot: Canary run 2026-03-15T10:22Z: 2/3 canaries healthy, failed: canary-2 TLS error. See logs: https://logs.internal/canary/1823456789

anika: Security note — if customer is terminating TLS at their load balancer we need to confirm mutual TLS vs simple TLS. Also need KMS/HSM key wrap plan for private deployment. @devon can you share the KMS contact? 

devon: KMS contact is raul (rsa-team). Raul, can you confirm HSM access process for Acme? Also I filed a CR: #PR-4827 — needs review from eng-security and eng-sre.

raul: Confirmed — HSM onboarding needs a signed access request + IP allowlist. I'll share the template today. Also adding item: customer uses an air-gapped provisioning jumpbox; we need offline image signing steps. 

miriam: Great — owners: devon for network/NAT, kai for canary rollout, raul for HSM/onboarding, anika for security signoff. Milestone: blocklist cleared by EOD Fri. If any blocker remains, flag here. :thumbsup:
